packageRules.description: Automerge minor/patch updates via platform auto-merge.
Group all GitHub Actions updates into one PR

Never pin to SHA digests — not container images (Dockerfile, Helm values, manifests) and not GitHub Actions. Tag-level updates are the granularity we want; digest churn is noise. This rule guards against a preset (e.g. config:best-practices) re-enabling it.

The Kubernetes staging modules move as a set — a client-go that disagrees with apimachinery does not build — so they share one PR. Minor bumps can move the resource.k8s.io API surface the driver publishes against, so they wait for review; patches automerge.
The Go toolchain in go.mod and the golang image in the Dockerfile move together, or the image builds with a toolchain the module does not declare.

netlink is tracked at an untagged commit because sriovnet requires a post-v1.3.1 pseudo-version. The version we need is dictated by sriovnet, so skip standalone digest bumps; the sriovnet update PR pulls the matching netlink commit via go mod tidy.

customManagers.description: The Helm version azure/setup-helm installs. It is a tool version rather than a dependency, so the github-actions manager cannot see it.
